hypothesis: A query-blind online intervention scheduler can recognize early public-prefix relationship evidence that justifies a source-legal single memory exception to frozen F60, without over-intervening on ordinary within-component questions.
distinct_mechanism: Train binary signed counterfactual improvement over frozen F60, with task answer used only in offline FIT TRAIN teacher labels. Runtime uses only endpoint/candidate role-record differences, memory pressure and local public incident evidence to predict whether an alternative state is useful. No absolute event index as a feature, no special rule for observed F70B index 2 or 14.

frozen_method.candidate_generation: F62 ACTION.actions native legal alternatives only
frozen_method.oracle_training: Per TRAIN public step enumerate source-legal alternative states, run unchanged F60 suffix over TRAIN public events, compare TRAIN question correctness against F60 suffix; label beneficial +1, harmful -1, neutral -0.25. No oracle actions deployed.
prediction_features: current edge endpoints previously present fraction
candidate minus baseline distinct role code count/8
frozen_method.loss: 3 deterministic epochs signed counterfactual prediction via tanh squared-error SGD, lr 0.025, class weights beneficial=4 harmful=1 neutral=0.1, then quantize round(32*w) signed int8
frozen_method.online_decision: Only choose native alternative if highest predictor score > 0.05; otherwise exact F60 default; no persisted model state beyond 12 packed records.
